Maria (CS): Hey @Eric (SRE) @Anita (Security) — Opal cutover status: network peering done, routing looks OK from our side but KMS access is blocking the rollout to private. Customer mentioned audit logs not appearing in their SIEM after the test ingestion. Can we triage?
Eric (SRE): Looking now. I see a duplicate route in the peering table that could cause asymmetric traffic to the bastion. I'll remove the 10.2.0.0/16 overlap and re-run connectivity checks. ETA ~90m.
Anita (Security): KMS issue sounds like we didn't include the customer service account in the CMK policy. Need the exact principal ARN for Opal app-sa. @Maria (CS) do you have that?
Maria (CS): Sending the principal below — confirmed from the customer's infra team. Also flagging a potential renewal risk: they called out "audit visibility" as a blocker for go-live and asked for a written remediation timeline.
Maria (CS): principal: arn:aws:iam::987654321012:role/opal-app-sa
Siva (Platform): FYI, our Private agent needs kms:Decrypt + kms:GenerateDataKey on the CMK and cross-account trust. Anita, sample policy snippet here:
Siva (Platform): ```
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::987654321012:role/opal-app-sa"},
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```
Anita (Security): That'll work but we should scope Resource to the CMK ARN and add a Condition for aws:SourceVpc to limit access. I'll draft the tightened statement and post.
deploy-bot: Deployment queued: private-cutover/op-al -- build 2026.03.17-5 queued by maria_cs
Eric (SRE): Post-patch connectivity checks all green from our side. I also validated that the SNAT on the NAT gateway is stable. Can someone confirm the customer's SIEM ingestion? @Maria (CS)
Maria (CS): Reached out to Opal infra, they confirmed event batch arrived but parsing failed due to timestamp format. They've updated the parser and will re-send this afternoon.
Anita (Security): I'll attach the recommended audit log retention policy and the list of events we expect (vpc.flow, kms.audit, app.access). Also creating an action item for a joint smoke test with the customer and support docs.
Maria (CS): Action items: 1) Anita to post CMK policy update + Condition (owner: Anita) 2) Eric to verify peering/routing after change (owner: Eric) 3) Siva to confirm Private agent KMS roles (owner: Siva) 4) Maria to schedule joint smoke test and capture timeline for Opal execs (owner: Maria). Target: smoke test tomorrow 16:00 UTC.
Siva (Platform): I'll also capture cost/throughput notes for the Private run so Opal can see SLA vs expected spend — helps with renewal conversation.
Maria (CS): Thanks team. I'll update the customer board and tag this as "renewal-watch" until smoke test passes. Ping me if anything slips.
Eric (SRE): 👍 will report progress in 60m.
Anita (Security): Posting policy in #eng-security once drafted. :lock:
Maria (CS): Closing loop for now — will post results from the smoke test thread here. Thanks!
